Source   Edit  

more_tools.nim — metadata constants for the extended native tool set. Pure helpers (calc, globMatch) live in calc.nim. Execution lives in app/native_tools.nim.

Consts

AskToolDescription = "Ask the user a clarifying question and wait for their reply. Use when you need information that isn\'t available from context. Returns the user\'s exact response text, or an interruption error if the session is rebuilt."
Source   Edit   
AskToolName = "ask"
Source   Edit   
AskToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"question\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Question to ask the user\"}},\"required\":[\"question\"]}"
Source   Edit   
AwaitToolDescription = "Wait for one or more background jobs created by task and return lines in the form job_id: result."
Source   Edit   
AwaitToolName = "await"
Source   Edit   
AwaitToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"job_ids\":{\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"description\":\"Job IDs to wait for\"}},\"required\":[\"job_ids\"]}"
Source   Edit   
BashToolDescription = "Execute a shell command and return stdout+stderr. Use for system operations, running scripts, git commands, and build tools. Commands run inside the agent paddock when available."
Source   Edit   
BashToolName = "bash"
Source   Edit   
BashToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"command\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Shell command to run\"},\"timeout\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Timeout in seconds (default 30)\"}},\"required\":[\"command\"]}"
Source   Edit   
CalcToolDescription = "Evaluate a math expression. Supports +, -, *, /, % (modulo), ** (power), parentheses, unary ±. Literals: decimal, 0xFF hex, 0b binary, 0o octal."
Source   Edit   
CalcToolName = "calc"
Source   Edit   
CalcToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"expression\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Math expression to evaluate\"}},\"required\":[\"expression\"]}"
Source   Edit   
CancelJobToolDescription = "Cancel a background job created by task using its job_id."
Source   Edit   
CancelJobToolName = "cancel_job"
Source   Edit   
CancelJobToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"job_id\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Job ID to cancel\"}},\"required\":[\"job_id\"]}"
Source   Edit   
CheckpointToolDescription = "Save a snapshot of the current conversation history. Use before exploratory or destructive operations. Returns the checkpoint index for later use with rewind."
Source   Edit   
CheckpointToolName = "checkpoint"
Source   Edit   
CheckpointToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"label\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Optional label for this checkpoint\"}}}"
Source   Edit   
CpToolDescription = "Copy a file. Runs sandboxed via WASM."
Source   Edit   
CpToolName = "cp"
Source   Edit   
CpToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"source\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Source file path\"},\"dest\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Destination file path\"}},\"required\":[\"source\",\"dest\"]}"
Source   Edit   
EditFileToolDescription = "Apply precise in-place file edits using hashline anchors from read_file. Supports replace, prepend, and append operations. If the file changed since the last read, stale anchors are rejected."
Source   Edit   
EditFileToolName = "edit_file"
Source   Edit   
EditFileToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File path to edit\"},\"edits\":{\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"op\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"replace\",\"prepend\",\"append\"]},\"pos\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Anchor LINE#ID for the target line\"},\"end\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Inclusive end anchor for replace ranges\"},\"lines\":{\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"description\":\"Literal replacement or inserted lines; empty array deletes for replace\"}}},\"description\":\"Edits applied bottom-up\"}},\"required\":[\"path\",\"edits\"]}"
Source   Edit   
FetchToolDescription = "Fetch a URL and return cleaned text content. HTML tags are stripped, JSON is pretty-printed. Does not allow private/internal addresses."
Source   Edit   
FetchToolName = "fetch"
Source   Edit   
FetchToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"url\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"URL to fetch\"},\"max_chars\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Max characters to return (default: 5000, hard cap: 20000)\"}},\"required\":[\"url\"]}"
Source   Edit   
FindToolDescription = "Find files or directories by glob pattern. Pattern supports * (any sequence) and ? (one char). Example: pattern=\'*.nim\', type=\'file\'."
Source   Edit   
FindToolName = "find"
Source   Edit   
FindToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Directory to search\"},\"pattern\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Glob pattern (default: *)\"},\"type\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"file\",\"dir\",\"any\"],\"description\":\"Filter by type (default: file)\"},\"max\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Max results (default: 50)\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
GrepToolDescription = "Search file contents for a literal string pattern. Returns matching lines as \'file:linenum:content\'. Recursively searches directories by default. For regex, use bash(\"grep -rn \'pattern\' /path\")."
Source   Edit   
GrepToolName = "grep"
Source   Edit   
GrepToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"pattern\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Literal string pattern to search for\"},\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File or directory to search\"},\"recursive\":{\"type\":\"boolean\",\"description\":\"Recurse into subdirectories (default: true)\"},\"max\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Max matches (default: 50)\"}},\"required\":[\"pattern\",\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
HeadToolDescription = "Return the first N lines of a file. Runs sandboxed via WASM."
Source   Edit   
HeadToolName = "head"
Source   Edit   
HeadToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File to read\"},\"lines\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Number of lines (default: 10)\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
InspectImageToolDescription = "Analyze a local image file using a vision-capable AI model. Reads the file, encodes it, and sends it to the active provider. Returns the model\'s description or answer to your prompt. If prompt is omitted, it asks for a detailed description."
Source   Edit   
InspectImageToolName = "inspect_image"
Source   Edit   
InspectImageToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Local image file path\"},\"prompt\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"What to analyze (default: describe this image)\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
ManageSkillsToolDescription = "Search the remote skill registry, install remote bundles, enable/disable skills, or read the SKILL.md content of any installed remote skill bundle. Use this when you need a capability not already available, or when the user asks how to install or enable a skill, or when you want to read the content of a skill\'s SKILL.md."
Source   Edit   
ManageSkillsToolName = "manage_skills"
Source   Edit   
ManageSkillsToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"help\",\"list\",\"search\",\"install\",\"enable\",\"disable\",\"read\"],\"description\":\"Skill management action\"},\"query\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Search query for action=search\"},\"slug\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Bundle slug for install/enable/read\"},\"name\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Enabled skill name for action=disable\"},\"registry\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Optional registry override\"}}}"
Source   Edit   
MkdirToolDescription = "Create a directory. Runs sandboxed via WASM."
Source   Edit   
MkdirToolName = "mkdir"
Source   Edit   
MkdirToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Directory to create\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
MvToolDescription = "Move or rename a file. Runs sandboxed via WASM."
Source   Edit   
MvToolName = "mv"
Source   Edit   
MvToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"source\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Source file path\"},\"dest\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Destination file path\"}},\"required\":[\"source\",\"dest\"]}"
Source   Edit   
ReadFileToolDescription = "Read a local file and return each line prefixed with a stable hashline anchor in the form LINE#ID:text. Use this before edit_file. The anchors act as both addresses and stale-read checks."
Source   Edit   
ReadFileToolName = "read_file"
Source   Edit   
ReadFileToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File path to read\"},\"start_line\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"First line number to return (default: 1)\"},\"max_lines\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Maximum lines to return (default: 200)\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
RenderMermaidToolDescription = "Render a Mermaid diagram. If mmdc (Mermaid CLI) is installed, generates an SVG file and returns its path. Otherwise returns the source formatted for display."
Source   Edit   
RenderMermaidToolName = "render_mermaid"
Source   Edit   
RenderMermaidToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"diagram\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Mermaid diagram source\"}},\"required\":[\"diagram\"]}"
Source   Edit   
ReportFindingToolDescription = "Report an intermediate finding during a background or delegated task. Used to surface partial results without ending the task. Returns the finding acknowledged."
Source   Edit   
ReportFindingToolName = "report_finding"
Source   Edit   
ReportFindingToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"finding\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Intermediate finding to report\"}},\"required\":[\"finding\"]}"
Source   Edit   
RewindToolDescription = "Restore conversation history to a previously saved checkpoint. Discards all history after the checkpoint. Use checkpoint index from the checkpoint tool output."
Source   Edit   
RewindToolName = "rewind"
Source   Edit   
RewindToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"index\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Checkpoint index (default: last checkpoint)\"}}}"
Source   Edit   
RmToolDescription = "Remove a file. Runs sandboxed via WASM."
Source   Edit   
RmToolName = "rm"
Source   Edit   
RmToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File to remove\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
SedToolDescription = "Stream editor for text transformations. Supports substitution (s/pattern/replacement/flags), deletion (d), print (-n with /pattern/p), and line addressing. Runs sandboxed via WASM. Example: expression=\'s/old/new/g\'."
Source   Edit   
SedToolName = "sed"
Source   Edit   
SedToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"expression\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"sed expression (e.g. s/old/new/g, /pattern/d)\"},\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File to process\"}},\"required\":[\"expression\",\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
SortToolDescription = "Sort lines of text. Runs sandboxed via WASM. Flags: -r (reverse), -n (numeric), -u (unique)."
Source   Edit   
SortToolName = "sort"
Source   Edit   
SortToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File to sort\"},\"flags\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Flags: -r, -n, -u, -rn, etc.\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
SubmitResultToolDescription = "Submit the final result of a background or delegated task. In the current single-agent runtime, returns the result verbatim."
Source   Edit   
SubmitResultToolName = "submit_result"
Source   Edit   
SubmitResultToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"result\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Final result to submit\"}},\"required\":[\"result\"]}"
Source   Edit   
TailToolDescription = "Return the last N lines of a file. Runs sandboxed via WASM."
Source   Edit   
TailToolName = "tail"
Source   Edit   
TailToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File to read\"},\"lines\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Number of lines (default: 10)\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
TaskToolDescription = "Start a focused background subtask using the active AI model. Returns a job_id immediately; use await to collect results and cancel_job to stop it. Use for independent research or analysis that can run separately from the current turn."
Source   Edit   
TaskToolName = "task"
Source   Edit   
TaskToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"prompt\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Task for the model to complete\"},\"context\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Additional context for the model\"}},\"required\":[\"prompt\"]}"
Source   Edit   
TodoWriteToolDescription = "Manage a session todo list. ops: array of {op, id?, title?, phase?, notes?}. op: \'create\' | \'update\' | \'delete\'. phase: \'backlog\' | \'in_progress\' | \'completed\'. Returns the full current todo list after applying ops."
Source   Edit   
TodoWriteToolName = "todo_write"
Source   Edit   
TodoWriteToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"ops\":{\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"op\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"create\",\"update\",\"delete\"]},\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"title\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"phase\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"enum\":[\"backlog\",\"in_progress\",\"completed\"]},\"notes\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}}},\"required\":[\"ops\"]}"
Source   Edit   
WcToolDescription = "Count lines, words, and characters in files. Runs sandboxed via WASM. Flags: -l (lines), -w (words), -c (chars)."
Source   Edit   
WcToolName = "wc"
Source   Edit   
WcToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"path\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"File to count\"},\"flags\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Flags: -l, -w, -c (default: all)\"}},\"required\":[\"path\"]}"
Source   Edit   
WebSearchToolDescription = "Search the web using Brave Search API. Returns titles, URLs, and descriptions for the top results. Requires BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable."
Source   Edit   
WebSearchToolName = "web_search"
Source   Edit   
WebSearchToolSchema = "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"query\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Search query\"},\"count\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"description\":\"Number of results (default: 5, max: 20)\"}},\"required\":[\"query\"]}"
Source   Edit
